description: This file contains functions and types for managing legacy state detection, migration plans, and automated migration processes for session and agent state directories in the OpenClaw project. It includes logic for handling filesystem operations, session key canonicalization, and migration workflows.

classes.name: LegacyStateDetection
classes.description: Type representing detected legacy state components including agent ID, main key, session directories, and migration plans.

classes.name: MigrationLogger
classes.description: Type defining logging functions for migration processes.

classes.name: LegacySessionSurface
classes.description: Type for surfaces that can identify legacy group session keys and canonicalize legacy session keys.

methods.name: getLegacySessionSurfaces
methods.description: Retrieves surfaces that can handle legacy session keys from bundled channel contract surfaces.

methods.name: isSurfaceGroupKey
methods.description: Checks if a session key is a group or channel key.

methods.name: isLegacyGroupKey
methods.description: Determines if a session key is a legacy group key based on surfaces.

methods.name: buildLegacyMigrationPreview
methods.description: Creates a string preview of a migration plan.

methods.name: runLegacyMigrationPlans
methods.description: Executes migration plans for legacy state, moving or copying files as needed.

methods.name: canonicalizeSessionKeyForAgent
methods.description: Canonicalizes session keys for a specific agent, handling legacy and cross-agent keys.

methods.name: pickLatestLegacyDirectEntry
methods.description: Selects the most recent direct session entry from a store.

methods.name: normalizeSessionEntry
methods.description: Normalizes a session entry, ensuring it has a sessionId and proper structure.

methods.name: resolveUpdatedAt
methods.description: Resolves the updatedAt timestamp of a session entry.

methods.name: mergeSessionEntry
methods.description: Merges two session entries, preferring the most recent.

methods.name: canonicalizeSessionStore
methods.description: Canonicalizes session store entries, merging duplicates and legacy keys.

methods.name: listLegacySessionKeys
methods.description: Lists session keys that are legacy or non-canonical.

methods.name: emptyDirOrMissing
methods.description: Checks if a directory is empty or missing.

methods.name: removeDirIfEmpty
methods.description: Removes a directory if it is empty.

methods.name: detectLegacyStateMigrations
methods.description: Detects legacy state directories and plans for migration.

methods.name: migrateLegacySessions
methods.description: Migrates legacy session data to new storage.

methods.name: migrateLegacyAgentDir
methods.description: Migrates legacy agent directories.

methods.name: migrateChannelLegacyStatePlans
methods.description: Runs migration plans for channel legacy state.

methods.name: runLegacyStateMigrations
methods.description: Runs all legacy state migrations including sessions, agent dirs, and channel plans.

methods.name: autoMigrateLegacyState
methods.description: Performs automatic migration of legacy state directories and session keys.

methods.name: autoMigrateLegacyAgentDir
methods.description: Performs automatic migration of legacy agent directories.

methods.name: migrateOrphanedSessionKeys
methods.description: Canonicalizes orphaned session keys across all known session stores.

methods.name: autoMigrateLegacyStateDir
methods.description: Automatically migrates legacy state directory if needed.

methods.name: resetAutoMigrateLegacyStateForTest
methods.description: Resets migration check state for testing.

methods.name: resetAutoMigrateLegacyAgentDirForTest
methods.description: Resets agent dir migration check state for testing.

methods.name: resetAutoMigrateLegacyStateDirForTest
methods.description: Resets state dir migration check state for testing.
